user.title: Authenticate
user.description: Set the assistant defaults, then continue to xAI OAuth sign-in.

device_auth.title: xAI sign-in
device_auth.description:
1. Open [the xAI device sign-in page]({verification_url}).
2. Enter code **{user_code}** if it is not prefilled.
3. Approve access. xAI may label the app as Grok Build.
4. Return here, check the box, and submit.

error.authorization_pending: xAI has not confirmed authorization yet. Finish approval, then submit again.

abort.oauth_error: xAI returned an invalid OAuth response.
abort.cannot_connect: Authenticated, but the xAI API test request failed. Verify that your account has OAuth model access and try again.
